as_told.title: Gimbal as an optical effect rotated by a de-rotation mechanism

plain: Mick West, a UFO skeptic, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that the turning seen in the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy cockpit recording made off Florida, is probably a camera artifact. He says a mechanism inside the camera that keeps the image upright makes a blurry glare spin, and at one point he applies the same idea to the object's shape too. If he is right, the object's famous rotation would not be the object moving at all.
